testNames: MyTasks sends exactly one project plus server filters/cursor and preserves calendar envelope
all remaining feed APIs preserve exact continuation and AbortSignal
explicit unauthorized task scope never falls back, current authorized scope wins default
session401 overrides stale actor data; access fingerprint ignores display edits and catches scope changes
real query client continuation preserves server order, and refresh replaces the entire loaded cursor chain
access refusal clears protected cached row bodies and leaves the actual error status intact
canonical workspace calendar controls colors regardless of browser day or a skipped local date
audit dates cover explicit UTC days and invalid ranges never query
workspace/project audit and accessible project list forward exact opaque cursors/server filters and abort
image gallery actual shared envelope retains items/count/null cursor without legacy fallback
one file goes prepare, create, put, finalize and then leaves the list
several files are handled one at a time, in order
the item says validating, not saved, while finalize is pending
a failed transfer keeps its original staging and prepared bytes until retry or explicit cancellation
cancel during upload aborts the transfer, cancels the staged upload and never finalizes
cancel of a waiting file removes it before any work starts
uploads of different cards do not mix
lost staging reply retries the same original key/input and prepares only once
unknown finalize never cancels/restarts and keeps original finalize key across retry
identity loss between prepare and staging prevents another protected request
